If b+K+3R<=D then their representative-independent multiplication maps on the same full [wV_K] obey ker M_E' subset ker M_E and rank M_E'>=rank M_E. Weight survival unnecessary. Proof propagates t(1+Q_v)=0 from the root, then Q_v=F_vP_v and Booleanity force t(1+P_v)=0; actual-degree resets prevent depth accumulation. No universal compiler cone coverage or legal filter construction is asserted; original source B,T,slots,shared choices and replay are separate application premises.
